entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (GABRA1, a pentameric ion-channel subunit). Of eight missense variants, five lower total alpha1 protein and seven lower surface alpha1 in HEK293T cells; the protein losses are variant-specific and partial.
entries.snippet: Western blot analysis demonstrated that five variations (S76R, R214C, D219N, P260L, and A322D) reduced the total α1 subunit protein levels significantly compared to wild type

experimental_context.system: GABA-A receptor alpha1 subunit missense variants (S76R, R214C, D219N, G251D, P260L, M263T, T289P, A322D) with beta2 and gamma2 in HEK293T cells (transient and stable), and a heterozygous G251D knock-in human iPSC line differentiated to GABAergic neurons; two positive allosteric modulators of the receptor tested as pharmacological chaperones; NOT a WWOX system
experimental_context.genotype: GABRA1 eight missense variants; no WWOX
experimental_context.endpoint: total and surface alpha1 by Western blot and biotinylation, pellet-to-supernatant ratio, peak GABA current, FRET, endo H, cycloheximide chase, proximity ligation
